lines.text: So how has the lower back been since last time?
Since last time the right hip has been better, but it's really stiff in the morning.
Okay, I'll do some massage through the right glute today and we'll recheck.
Good, that's us for today, see you next week.
Morning appointments suit me better if you've got one.
No worries, I'll pop you in for Tuesday morning.
Oh, and the tingling in my right foot is worst first thing in the morning.
Thanks for telling me, we'll keep an eye on that next time.
